title: Bounded metric label set
description: The label set attached to one OpenTelemetry metric emission. propertyNames is restricted to a fixed, low-cardinality key enum so a high-cardinality key (vehicle_id, track_id, event_id) structurally cannot pass validation, per docs/environment/RESOURCE_BUDGET.md: 'vehicle/track IDs never become metric labels.' Trace and log attributes are not bound by this contract; only metric labels carry this cardinality risk.

labels.description: Every key must be one of the enumerated low-cardinality dimensions. device_id and intersection_id are intentionally excluded here; per-device/intersection breakdowns belong on traces/logs, not unbounded metric label sets, unless a separate cardinality test explicitly approves a named exception.
